description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarAuthenticate, which manages user authentication, login, session validation, and related security features within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for login, session management, IP validation, password encoding, and logout handling.

classes.name: SugarAuthenticate
classes.description: Class responsible for handling user authentication, session management, password handling, and security features in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that loads the user authentication class file based on configuration and instantiates it.

methods.name: loginAuthenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, manages login errors, and handles password expiration checks.

methods.name: postLoginAuthenticate
methods.description: Post-login setup: initializes session variables, user preferences, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: sessionAuthenticate
methods.description: Verifies if current session is valid, checks IP consistency, and manages user session authentication.

methods.name: postSessionAuthenticate
methods.description: Performs post-session validation, including cross-site session security and multi-factor authentication.

methods.name: addFactorMessage
methods.description: Stores a message related to multi-factor authentication in the session.

methods.name: getFactorMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears stored multi-factor authentication messages from the session.

methods.name: validateIP
methods.description: Ensures the client's IP address matches the one stored in the session to prevent hijacking.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Destroys the current session and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: encodePassword
methods.description: Static method that returns an MD5 hash of the password in lowercase.

methods.name: canChangePassword
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to change their password (always true here).

methods.name: canChangeUserName
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to change their username (always true here).

methods.name: pre_login
methods.description: Performs pre-login steps, such as redirecting if a user is already authenticated.

methods.name: redirectToLogin
methods.description: Redirects the user to the login page.
